direct_mechanisms: virus-host interactome; proximity proteomics; AP-MS/affinity purification mass spectrometry; host restriction/dependency factors; viral protein-host protein binding; ubiquitin/proteasome turnover; autophagy/ER-phagy; vesicle trafficking/entry; interferon/innate immune antagonism; nuclear import/RNA processing
supporting_mechanisms: comparative pan-viral host-factor resources; flavivirus/retrovirus/filovirus pathway comparators; host lipid/secretory pathway context; transcriptomic or phosphoproteomic infection responses when tied to mechanism
retained_keyword_families: primary virus name AND (interactome OR AP-MS OR affinity purification mass spectrometry OR proximity proteomics OR BioID); primary virus name AND (host factor OR restriction factor OR dependency factor OR entry factor) AND mechanism; primary virus name AND (viral protein OR virus protein) AND (interacts OR binds OR recruits OR cleaves OR degrades); primary virus name AND (CRISPR screen OR RNAi screen OR functional genomics) AND host factor
noise_keyword_families: host pathway without interaction/factor/viral-protein anchor; proteomic biomarker or plasma/serum omics in patient cohorts; network pharmacology or molecular docking antiviral screens; vaccine/diagnostic/epidemiology papers; broad antiviral scaffold reviews; non-primary virus omics papers retrieved only through generic pathway terms
missing_keyword_families: viral protein-host protein; proximity proteomics; protein interaction mapping; CRISPR screen; RNAi screen; restriction factor; dependency factor; entry factor; ubiquitin ligase; ER-phagy; reticulophagy; nuclear import; RNA-binding proteins; replication complex
recommended_query_changes: For pass 2, replace broad per-virus host pathway/proteomic queries with two-tier query families: (1) primary virus names paired with assay terms: interactome, AP-MS, affinity purification mass spectrometry, proximity proteomics, BioID, protein interaction mapping; (2) primary virus names paired with mechanistic host-factor terms plus action verbs: host factor, restriction factor, dependency factor, entry factor, viral protein-host protein, interacts, binds, recruits, cleaves, degrades, modulates. Keep pathway terms only when paired with a host-factor or viral-protein action anchor. Add rescue queries for CRISPR/RNAi functional genomics host-factor papers. Exclude or strongly downweight patient biomarker omics, plasma/serum proteomics, network pharmacology, molecular docking, vaccine, diagnostic, and epidemiology wording.
recommended_abstract_rule_changes: Reviewer 1/2 should not include patient biomarker, clinical coinfection, generic metabolomics, drug-screen, or network-pharmacology records unless the title/abstract names a primary virus and a specific host factor, viral protein-host protein interaction, perturbation assay, or pathway mechanism. Require each include rationale to state direct AP-MS/interactome evidence, host-factor mechanism, pathway-convergence evidence, or authorized comparator mechanism.
rationale: Reviewed 1580 PMC-normalized full texts from pass 1: keep=1337, drop=243, direct=964, indirect=373, weak/background=243. The learning set shows enough repeated noise and useful in-scope mechanism language to revise pass 2 queries before requesting PDFs.
